newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Stomil Sanok not to underwrite new issue.
newsitem.headline: Polish Stomil Sanok not to underwrite new issue.

text.p: Poland's rubber company Stomil Sanok SA does not want to seek underwriters for its November issue of 500,000 shares, the firm's president said on Tuesday.
"The 500,000 share issue is so small, that the borad does not plan to underwrite it," Marek Lecki told a meeting of investors.
"The board considers the 25 zloty per share price attractive enough for the whole issue to be bought without any problems," he added.
The company will offer the shares to investors between November 4 and November 15. Investors may buy up to 20,000 shares each.
The share capital of Stomil Sanok, which wants to enter the main market of the Warsaw bourse around the turn of the year, is divided into 4.7 million shares approved for public trade.
